items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the spectral sequence of a filtered differential object, in the graded category, with differentials d_r : E_r -> E_r[r] and first pages the associated graded and its cohomology (statement lines 5965-5975). The proof is a complete argument: the countable-direct-sum case comes from the preceding discussion; in general the author constructs a graded differential object out of the filtration steps, proves the natural inclusion is an injective morphism of differential objects, applies the abstract construction with the shift [1] (proof lines 5977-6000), and unwinds the definitions to identify E_0 and E_1 (proof lines 6002-6011). The non-formal content is the choice of the graded object and the unwinding. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
